register_stt_serialisers: register custom serializers and deserializers for boolean, bytearray, and text types with the actionengine serializer registry
bool_to_bytes: convert a python boolean value to a single byte for binary serialization
bytes_to_bool: deserialize a single byte back into a python boolean value
str_to_bytes: encode a python string to utf-8 bytes for binary serialization
bytes_to_str: decode utf-8 bytes back into a python string
